report_name: 60% of Critical Infrastructure Orgs Breached in Past Year: Report

vulnerabilities.name: Unpatchable Legacy OT Systems
vulnerabilities.description: Legacy Operational Technology (OT) systems that cannot be easily patched or monitored with modern IT security tools were cited by 42% of surveyed organizations as their single biggest cybersecurity risk.

identities.name: Critical Infrastructure Organizations
identities.description: A class of organizations from a global survey where 60% reported a significant security breach in the past year, facing risks from unpatchable legacy OT systems and fragmented security operations.

indicators.name: Anomalous Modbus Traffic Detected
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Modbus Traffic Detected
id: 9c5b1a3d-6e4f-4b8c-8d2a-1b9c8f7a6e5d
status: experimental
description: Detects Modbus traffic (TCP port 502), which is common in OT/ICS environments. While not inherently malicious, its presence on IT networks or crossing unexpected network boundaries can indicate misconfiguration or malicious activity.
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/reports/palo-alto-reports-legacy-ot-systems-fragmented-security-tools-undermine-critical-infrastructure-cyber-resilience/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-10
tags:
  - attack.t0869
level: low
logsource:
  category: firewall
detection:
  selection:
    dst_port: 502
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects network traffic on TCP port 502, used by the Modbus industrial protocol. The report highlights the need for monitoring OT-specific protocols.
